stackVars.caption: Values come from this table. A variable with no value here uses the default written in the compose file, like ${NAME:-default}. Coaming fills them in itself before it deploys.

empty.title: No variables
empty.body: The compose file doesn't use any ${VARIABLES}, and none are added. Add one, or import a .env file.

stackVars.secretHelp: A secret value is stored encrypted and shows as •••• everywhere. Only users who can reveal secrets can read it.

errors.name: Use letters, numbers and underscores, and don't start with a number.
errors.taken: That variable is already in the table.

row.turnedOff: The saved value stays hidden, so type it again to make it plain text.
row.revealDenied: Needs the reveal secrets permission to show this value.
row.revealFailed: Couldn't load the value. Try again.

git.committedTip: Committed in the repository. Hidden here because the name looks like a secret.
git.secretLike: {{name}} looks like a secret and is committed in the repository's .env. Set a secret variable here to override it.
